title: Multi-device programs: profiling-driven OpenACC, MPI with CUDA, and MPI with OpenACC
status: reviewed and locally validated; independent round 2 ACCEPT
transcript_provenance: Local machine transcription (faster-whisper small.en); not publisher captions
source_uncertainties: No original audio replay was performed; public corrections concern visible source frames, not unverified speech.
One physical GPU only. No multi-GPU speedup, peer transfer, cross-node scaling, GPU-aware MPI operation or asynchronous-overlap experiment was performed.
Open MPI 4.1.6 reports built_with_cuda_support false; every executed MPI buffer is host memory.
The source profiling slide shows phase times summing to40.53s alongside a39.43s total; its intervals do not resolve the inconsistency.
The teaching unsigned mixer is not a certified Monte Carlo generator; no independence or confidence-interval guarantee is claimed.

lecture_corrections.finding: Nested range percentages do not establish disjoint wall-time fractions; displayed phase19.04s+21.49s does not equal total39.43s.
Fixed CURAND initialization seed1234 and sequenceidx omit rank; equal per-rank work and geometry repeat streams.

Kernel includes left endpoint and host positive endpoint correction counts it once extra. h*sum g(rank/p) predicts shown two-/four-rank outputs. Source display has3.1415933736 and3.1415940061; machine transcript3.1459 is not a reliable displayed value.
Quarter-disk predicate differs from rational-integral comment; rand() is not a portable offload generator; trapezoid interior loop beginning1 is correctly weighted.
